name: To-Do List
description: Transform a conversation or ideas into a structured to-do list.
source: Reconstructed from Plaud community template 'To-Do List'.
outline: Extract every actionable task mentioned or implied in the transcript.
Present tasks as a checklist using '- [ ] ' markdown checkboxes.
For each task, append the owner in parentheses if a responsible person is identifiable.
Append a due date in the form (due: <date/time>) when a deadline is stated.
Group tasks under short headings when there are clearly distinct workstreams.
Do not invent tasks that are not grounded in the transcript.
example:
## Tasks
- [ ] Book the venue (Anna, due: Friday)
- [ ] Order catering
